name: @mercatus-liber/community-goals
description: Vote-threshold-gated feature unlocks (subsystem 26) -- a storefront publishes a Goal (a vote target, e.g. "1000 votes unlocks the live print stream"), customers/visitors cast one vote each (deduped by a caller-supplied voterKey), and the goal's status derives from voteCount vs its thresholds. Depends on @mercatus-liber/core only. Carries no UI/animation concern of its own -- the progress-bar/liquid-fill/gradient rendering a storefront builds on top of GoalStatus's plain numbers is entirely the storefront's own design-system work, same separation PDP/theming already draws from catalog.
